description: A line at the very end of the chat saying a restart (of the chat's host, or of Baude for a Desktop chat) cut its last turn short, with Continue to carry on.
opens: Opening (or being in) a chat whose last turn a restart cut short

parts.name: line
parts.shows: Left-aligned row, 8px gaps, 2px above: dimmed "Cut short by a restart" then a small "Continue" button (0.9em, 1px/8px padding). Always the last thing in the chat (moved down again if more is drawn after it).

actions.does: Sends "Continue where you left off: a restart cut your last turn short." as your message (what's typed and attached stays in the composer). Tooltip: "Send “Continue where you left off: a restart cut your last turn short.”".

states.name: continuing
states.shows: After Continue, until the turn starts: a spinner and dimmed "Continuing…".

states.name: couldn't continue
states.shows: If the message couldn't be sent, the line comes back with Continue.

states.name: gone
states.shows: Removed once anything is sent to the chat.
